description: Defines the class dmrs_pucch_estimator_format2, a DM-RS channel estimator for PUCCH Format 2, including methods for sequence generation and pattern mapping.

classes.name: dmrs_pucch_estimator_format2
classes.description: A class implementing DM-RS channel estimation for PUCCH Format 2, with sequence generation and pattern mapping functionalities.

methods.name: estimate
methods.description: Estimates the channel for a PUCCH Format 2 transmission.

methods.name: c_init
methods.description: Computes the initial pseudo-random state based on symbol index and configuration.

methods.name: generate_sequence
methods.description: Generates a DM-RS sequence according to TS38.211 specifications.

methods.name: generate_dmrs_pattern
methods.description: Generates the DM-RS allocation pattern for PUCCH Format 2.
